title: Tall cliff face
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Widow's Bay.
The same sea cliff as cliff-face (pale layered rock with green ivy, jutting ledges at many heights, a dark vertical gap in the rock), but twice as tall: surf breaking only at the very foot, grass and the cliff top only at the very top, the climb continuous between them with no repeated section. The dark gap runs from about 35% to 50% of the height up from the bottom, at about two-thirds of the width. Replaces the two stacked copies of cliff-face. Flat painted toy-theatre cut-out seen square-on, gouache on card with a faint pale cut edge; early-1900s stencil-tinted colour: sepia-grey line and tone with translucent washes of plum #2a1424, rose pink #f3c6dc, magenta #e0127a, moon gold #d9b34a, coral red #c8321e and grotto teal #5f8c88 laid slightly out of register; no cast shadow; no lettering; isolated on a transparent background (or flat pure magenta #FF00FF if transparency is unavailable).
Requested final aspect ratio 1400:3600. Real transparent alpha outside the isolated art.
Input image is a style/palette reference; follow the written subject and geometry rather than reproducing unwanted elements.
No text or watermark.
